verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Medusa serves llms.txt (HTTP 200 at docs.medusajs.com/llms.txt). The docs also include a dedicated 'build-with-llms-ai' section with markdown-formatted pages and a remote docs MCP server, so agents can query the documentation from tools like Cursor. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs effectively, and evidence of llms.txt depth (e.g., a full-content variant).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: The Medusa documentation provides a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows you to find information from the Medusa documentation right in your IDEs or AI tools, such as Cursor.
Medusa hosts a Streamable HTTP MCP server at `https://docs.medusajs.com/mcp` that you can add to AI agents supporting MCP server connections.
